## Problem and purpose

Explain the concrete problem and why this change is needed. Link the relevant issue or requirements.

## Scope and proposed behavior

Describe what changes, the affected documents or components, and the resulting behavior. Identify alternatives and unresolved assumptions.

## Process stage and authorization

Stage: research / requirements / process documentation / authorized specification / other.

Link the applicable decision record. State whether this pull request requests a decision or implements an already recorded documentation decision. Merging a research or documentation change does not itself approve the protocol or authorize implementation.

## Evidence and security implications

Link primary sources, exact revisions, and actual results. Explain relevant effects on the seven engineering cores, resource budgets, and failure behavior. Use the private security reporting process for sensitive findings.

## Validation performed

List only checks actually performed and their results. State which checks were not run and why. For a documentation-only change, describe the focused content and reference review; do not claim runtime tests, benchmarks, or an audit.

## Licensing and attribution

Identify third-party material and its origin and terms, or state that none was added. Note unresolved licensing decisions under `docs/LICENSING.md`.

## Revision or rollback

Explain how an incorrect change can be corrected or reverted and whether dependent documents would also need updates.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The scope is focused and matches the authorization described above.
- [ ] Facts, observations, assumptions, proposals, and open questions are distinguishable.
- [ ] Primary references and their limitations are recorded where relevant.
- [ ] Validation claims reflect work actually performed.
- [ ] No secrets, private reports, or unauthorized third-party data are included.
- [ ] Licensing and attribution questions are visible to the maintainer.
- [ ] The change does not imply an unrecorded gate decision, implementation approval, release, or deployment.

<!-- Leave incomplete items unchecked and explain them. Do not convert a missing assessment into PASS or CONDITIONAL PASS. -->
